messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT STARTED for customer CIT-A1 (Citadel Enterprises) — high-priority. Pager: platform-oncall. Potential log retention redaction exception during active mitigation.
platform-oncall: Oncall here, looking. What triggered the exception?
sara.mendez: Hey, we're seeing a spike of error-level logs in the customer's dedicated pool (pool-id: dpool-cit-03). During the DB failover the logging pipeline queued messages with user identifiers; retention policy flagged them for a short-term override.
ryan.kim: Quick context: Citadel uses Private VPC + Dedicated. Their retention policy is locked to 30d but they also requested a temporary debug hold for a legal review yesterday. Not sure the hold completed properly.
vikas.singh: I can confirm a manual retention_hold flag was set but there was an error applying redaction rules when we resumed ingestion. Some legacy parser emitted raw PII (email, account numbers) into the ES index.
ops-elena: Copy. Are the PII logs accessible from the console? We need to determine exposure scope before legal loop.
sara.mendez: Visibility: logs stored in customer-index-cit-a1, shard 7-9. Access limited to their VPC + audit-role. But we had to mount a recovery node in our infra to replay requests and that node had elevated access. That replay may have touched the unredacted docs.
platform-oncall: tag @legal-ana — we need guidance for preservation vs redaction and whether we can run automated redaction scripts in-place.
legal-ana: Thanks. Please do not modify or delete anything until I confirm. Preservation for eDiscovery is priority. We need a chain of custody and audit logs of any access/modification.
ryan.kim: Understood. We're pausing any destructive remediation. Can we snapshot the affected shards and then run redaction on a copy?
vikas.singh: Yes — suggested plan: (1) snapshot current shards to secure bucket (encrypted), (2) create an isolated cluster with read-only copies, (3) run deterministic redaction job that replaces PII fields with tokens and writes to a new index, (4) record checksums and publish audit entries.
sara.mendez: Estimated times: snapshot 12m, copy to isolated cluster 20m, redaction job depends on volume — ~45m for this dataset. Total ~80m.
ops-elena: Who needs access to the isolated copy for debugging?
ryan.kim: Keep access strictly to: sara.mendez, ryan.kim, vikas.singh, and one Citadel SE (citadel-sre). Add legal-ana as observer.
legal-ana: Also add compliance@citadel to the observer list and notify their legal counsel. We'll want a retention exception form filled — I can draft while you snapshot.
platform-oncall: Running snapshot command now: ```curl -XPOST https://es.prod.internal/_snapshot/cit-snap-2100001234 -H 'Authorization: Bearer /*vault*/' -d '{"indices":"customer-index-cit-a1"}'```
sara.mendez: Snapshot complete (12:03 UTC). Copy job started to isolated cluster: copy job id copy-7882.
ops-elena: Noted. I'm watching network egress and service account usage. No external downloads detected.
vikas.singh: Isolated cluster up. I'll run a quick grep to estimate PII volume: ```es-copy> POST /customer-index-cit-a1/_search?size=0 {"query":{"regexp":{"message":".*[0-9]{4}[- ]?[0-9]{4}[- ]?[0-9]{4}.*"}}}``` Preliminary: ~3.2k docs containing account-like patterns, ~220 with email-like patterns.
ryan.kim: Good work. We'll run the redaction on the isolated copy only. Script will produce mapping: original_doc_id -> redacted_doc_id + checksum.
legal-ana: Remember to record who ran the redaction and their keys. We'll need signed attestations for the chain of custody.
sara.mendez: Starting redaction job (job id redact-210000A). Command: ```python tools/redact.py --src http://isolated-es/customer-index-cit-a1 --dst http://isolated-es/customer-index-cit-a1-redacted --rules redaction/citadel-policy.json --log /tmp/redact-210000A.log```
ops-elena: Logging shows redact job started, throughput 200 docs/s, no elevated permission errors so far.
platform-oncall: Citadel SE (citadel-sre) joined the thread: "Would like to confirm data won't be deleted until we have legal clearance" — forwarding to legal-ana.
legal-ana: Confirmed. No deletions. We can proceed with redaction of copies. Also, prepare an incident memo for Citadel legal — include timestamps, operator list, and snapshot IDs.
ryan.kim: Redaction progress: 40% complete. Detected a secondary parser bug that left nested phone numbers unmasked. Patching rules now; will restart affected partitions. Estimated additional 15m delay.
sara.mendez: Patch applied, restart scheduled for partition workers 8-9. We'll keep track of skipped docs; none will be modified in primary cluster.
ops-elena: Quick question — do we have to file a formal retention exception in our internal system for this?
legal-ana: Yes, we need to record a temporary exception for Citadel in the retention register. I'll create it and add justification: "incident-mitigation and legal review pending".
platform-oncall: Redaction job complete at 13:27 UTC. Output: 3,278 redacted docs, 220 emails masked, 1,104 account numbers tokenized. Checksum file uploaded to secure bucket s3://incidents/citadel/2100001234/checksums.csv.gpg
sara.mendez: Running QA diff between redacted and original copies to confirm no structural changes besides PII tokens. QA passed for sampled docs (n=200).
ryan.kim: We should notify Citadel: provide a sanitized sample (5 docs) and the redaction report. @citadel-sre please ACK when you see it.
citadel-sre: ACK. We appreciate the careful handling. Please proceed to schedule a joint review tomorrow at 15:00 their local time.
legal-ana: Next steps from legal: (1) retention exception filed (ref REQ-2100001234), (2) incident memo drafted, (3) we will prepare a sealed copy of original snapshot for eDiscovery — access only with subpoena or formal request.
ops-elena: All actions documented in incident tracker: https://redwood.incidents/2100001234. I've attached logs: /var/logs/incidents/2100001234-redact.log (encrypted).
platform-oncall: Closing the active pager once postmortem steps are scheduled. Any objections?
sara.mendez: No objections. Recommend a short postmortem focusing on: retention hold lifecycle, parser hardening, and automated test for redaction rule coverage.
vikas.singh: I'll own parser hardening. Planning PR with unit tests and a replay test harness.
legal-ana: I'll coordinate with Citadel legal on the memo and retention exception form.
ryan.kim: Wrapping up: incident set to "mitigated". I'll file follow-up action items and link to QA artifacts. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
